title: Human-Centred, Risk-Constrained Evaluation of Financial Document Recognition: Evidence, Critical Errors, and Selective Automation
abstract: arXiv:2611.02775v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Financial document recognition is often assessed using character and word error rates, although these metrics do not express whether a system preserves the financial facts on which people and organisations act. This paper develops a human-centred, risk-constrained framework for evaluating financial document recognition as evidence recovery and decision support. It defines typed financial facts linked to visible source regions and separates verbatim transcription, deterministic normalization, and business interpretation. A layered quality model covers text, localization, layout, tables, fields, fact correctness, evidence grounding, uncertainty, robustness, and operational performance. Non-compensatory acceptance gates use one-sided uncertainty bounds for critical-field errors, preventing strong aggregate scores from masking failures in amounts, identifiers, signs, periods, or entity associations. translated_title: 以人为中心、风险约束的财务文档识别评估：证据、关键错误与选择性自动化
translated_abstract: 财务文档识别通常采用字符错误率和词错误率进行评估，但这些指标无法体现系统是否完整保留了人们和组织赖以决策的财务事实。本文构建了一个以人为中心、风险约束的评估框架，将财务文档识别视为证据恢复与决策支持任务。该框架定义了与可见源区域相关联的类型化财务事实，并将逐字转录、确定性规范化与业务解释三者区分开来。框架包含一个分层质量模型，覆盖文本、定位、布局、表格、字段、事实正确性、证据依据、不确定性、鲁棒性和运营性能等维度。其中，非补偿性验收门限对关键字段错误采用单侧不确定性界限，防止总体高分掩盖金额、标识符、符号、会计期间或实体关联等方面的失败。选择性自动化被公式化……（原文摘要截断于此）
tldr: 本文提出了一个以人为中心、风险约束的财务文档识别评估框架，通过类型化财务事实、分层质量模型和带单侧不确定性界限的非补偿性验收门限，防止总体高分掩盖金额、标识符等关键字段的错误，从而支撑可靠的选择性自动化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a human-centred, risk-constrained evaluation framework for financial document recognition that combines typed financial facts, a layered quality model, and non-compensatory acceptance gates with one-sided uncertainty bounds to prevent strong aggregate scores from masking critical errors in amounts, identifiers, signs, periods, or entity associations, thereby enabling selective automation.
